title: Late-Delivery Violation Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a late-delivery dispute that stands submitted concerns the account's most recent late-delivery violation and is decided by the agent on the record of that violation's batch. The decision removes from that violation either all of the points it was recorded with or none of them. The removal is booked as one cleared entry with removal reason "dispute upheld" and the dispute is marked decided.

A late-delivery violation covers a delivery completed more than the order's late threshold after its window.

## How the decision shows on the account

| Points removed | Dispute shows | Cleared entry | Active points |
|---|---|---|---|
| All of the recorded points (above zero) | Upheld | Booked for those points | Lower by those points |
| None (zero) | Denied | Booked for zero points | Unchanged |

## Tool: `decide_late_delivery_dispute_3251c6fd`

**Capability.** Decides a shopper's submitted dispute of a late-delivery violation, taking the given number of violation points off that violation. One call books one cleared entry against the disputed violation with removal reason `dispute_upheld` and the points removed, lowers the account's active violation points by the same number, and marks the dispute upheld when the number is above zero or denied when it is zero.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `decide_late_delivery_dispute_3251c6fd` and then calls it; it is an agent-side tool.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `shopper_account_id` | The shopper contractor account number the dispute belongs to, as returned by the shopper account lookup for the verified caller | Account reference, text |
| `shopper_appeal_id` | The reference number of the submitted violation dispute being decided, as returned by the shopper appeals lookup | Dispute reference, text |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the disputed late-delivery violation entry, as shown on the dispute and in the shopper account entries lookup | Entry reference, text |
| `points` | The violation points taken off the disputed violation | A whole non-negative integer, no decimals, no sign; the active points fall by exactly this integer |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("upheld" when points were removed, "denied" when the figure was zero; either means the decision was booked), `clearing_entry_id`, `shopper_appeal_id` and `source_event_id` (echoed back), `points_removed`, `violation_points_balance` (the active violation points after the decision) and `event_date` (the decision date, YYYY-MM-DD).
